checks.evidence: All three show exactly four full-body neutral figures in order front, three-quarter, profile, back, uncropped crown to soles with margins above hair and below shoes on one baseline at equal height and scale, arms relaxed slightly away with empty hands, same dotted teal shirt front, sides and back, no objects held.

All three show eight head-and-shoulders portraits in prompt order neutral, warm smile, pure joy, thoughtful concentration, determined resolve, gentle surprise, tender concern, playful mischief, each distinct via eyes, lids, brows, cheeks and mouth. Option 0 has all eyes open facing camera; Option 2 joy uses closed-eye broad smile still readable as joy and concentration uses hand-on-chin with sideways focus still readable; Option 1 matches its labels.
